title: Individual violence incident in the Lajas Blancas migrant reception camp
reason: The contemporaneous account describes an individual assault between migrants inside a reception camp, not a public gathering of at least 50 making a demand of the Panamanian state.
notes: SENAFRONT agents intervened and the Ombudsman visited to verify the incident. The source does not describe a protest or state action against demonstrators. Do not treat the camp population, official visit or the January 2021 human-rights report (S012) as a protest.
